reason: Our notices already reach students through the faculty WhatsApp groups, and anything extra we need I would ask our ERP vendor to add. I am not going to approve nine lakh a year, or open our Microsoft 365 and ERP to a small startup, to fix a problem nobody has brought to my desk.
objection: Students already get every notice on WhatsApp. This is one more app for them to ignore, and one more vendor holding student data that I answer for under DPDP, when our ERP vendor could probably add alerts.
would_change_my_mind: If our own ERP vendor offered it as a module, or if a pilot showed in our own numbers that missed submissions really fell, enough that the Vice-Chancellor or the academic council asked for it.
